A tray meal of sliced roasted poultry, mixed vegetables, and mixed fruit, with a glass of juice and a partially filled bottle that appears to contain chocolate milk. All three dishes are centrally placed on the tray, so I include them.

- **Vegetables:** shallow bowl, approximately **18 cm** diameter; area **254 cm²**.
